title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 182  An Act to Establish a National Agricultural High School in Bondoc Peninsula, Quezon Province, to Be Known as the Bondoc Peninsula Agricultural High School, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds therefor.

text.en:
There shall be establish under the direct supervision of the Director of the Bureau of Secondary
Education a national agricultural high school in Bondoc Peninsula, Quezon Province, in any of the following
municipalities: Catanauan, Mulanay, San Francisco, San Narciso, or San Andres, to be known as the Bondoc
Peninsula Agricultural High School. The site for the said institution shall be either in a public land of any said
municipalities, which is hereby set aside for this purpose, to be determined by the said Director in consultation
with the Director of Lands, or in a private land in any of said municipalities donated or acquired by purchase
for the purpose.

Upon the recommendation of the Director of Secondary Education, the President shall set aside
and reserve such portion of the public land located in any of said municipalities of said province as may be
necessary and convenient for the establishment of the school and farm site.

The amount of three hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be charged to
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 and Batas Pambansa Blg. 131, for the Ministry of
Education and Culture intended for new national high schools: Provided, That the local government unit
concerned shall continue to provide its share in the cost of operating and maintaining said school. Starting
Calendar Year 1983, such as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the school shall be
provided in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 5, 1982
